note: portfolio-v7 is an Astro application, not a component library — no Storybook, no dist/ of reusable components, private (non-published) package. The standard package/storybook converter has nothing to bundle. This is a hand-authored sync of design tokens + reusable CSS patterns (NOT a component bundle), so claude.ai/design produces designs that are 1:1 with the site. Re-derived 2026-08-17 from the split src/styles/ partials to match the current site (orange brand, cool neutrals, Google Sans, --subtle-foreground tier, radius 0.5rem, 600-weight headings).

source.patterns: src/styles/{base,components,prose,unlayered}.css (::selection, focus ring, headings, body links, .lead, .small-heading, .quiet-link, .card-raised, .prose) → patterns/{base,components,prose}.css
source.fonts: Google Sans 400/600 (src/assets/og/fonts GoogleSans-Regular/SemiBold.ttf — the site loads Google Sans via the Astro Google provider, no local woff2) + Berkeley Mono Regular/Bold/Oblique/Bold-Oblique + PermanentMarker-Regular (public/assets/fonts)
